head_mount.fastener: two internal M2.5 through-bolts, four washers, and two loose nyloc nuts per eye

rear_cap.fastener: two M2.5 through-bolts with washers and loose nyloc nuts per eye

materials.bucket_and_cap: opaque ASA; black exterior with a white reflective chamber liner
materials.diffuser: 1.5 mm frosted or milky translucent PETG

review_notes: Each eye is a separate light-tight module so its four addressable pixels can use a different color from the head glow panels.
The corrected annotated eye silhouette remains the visible aperture; an opaque bezel fills the unused area of the original oversized eye opening.

Two recessed internal flange screws retain each eye module at the outer-side and lower eye edges without creating exterior holes. Where the corrected outer eye edge is separated from the structural shell, a hidden 4 x 2 mm bridge supplies a continuous printed attachment path.
The rear cap is removable with two internal M2.5 through-bolts and carries a flat adhesive LED-strip area plus four diffuser-retaining posts.
The 100 mm-head-scale exports are visual and assembly-fit models only; use the full-size module or coupon to test LEDs, hardware, diffusion, heat, and light leakage.
